chunks: He has laid down for you the (same) way of life and belief which He had commended to Noah, and which We have enjoined on you, and which We had bequeathed to Abraham, Moses and Jesus, so that they should maintain the order and not be divided among themselves. Heavy is to idolaters what you invite them to. God chooses whom He please for Himself, and guides to Himself whoever turns to Him.
ai.seo_question: What is the common core of religion shared by all prophets according to Surah Ash-Shura?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the 'Usul al-Din' (principles of religion) as a unified core message delivered by the five arch-prophets (Al-Ulu al-Arab), with Muhammad (PBUH) as the final seal. It underscores the imperative of maintaining religious unity (Ittihad) against the fragmentation that plagued earlier communities, highlighting that divine guidance is reserved for those who sincerely return to God.
